verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only generic OpenAI SDK compatibility: change the base URL, API key and model. There is no first-party integration guide for any coding agent (e.g., an IDE agent) or agent framework. OpenAI compatibility is an adjacent building block that a user could rely on, not the documented integration guides this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides
